errors.GPS_DENIED: Location permission denied. Please enable in Settings.
errors.GPS_DISABLED: Location services are disabled. Enable them in system Settings.
errors.GPS_UNAVAILABLE: Cannot get GPS fix. Move to an open area and try again.
errors.GPS_TIMEOUT: GPS signal weak. Move to an open area and try again.
errors.GPS_MOCKED: Mock location detected. Disable fake GPS apps to check in.
errors.GPS_IP_MISMATCH: Location does not match your network region. Turn off VPN or fake GPS and try again.
errors.GPS_TZ_MISMATCH: Device timezone does not match your GPS location. Check clock/timezone settings or disable fake GPS.
errors.GPS_TELEPORT: That move is too fast to be real. Wait before checking in from a distant place.
errors.GPS_ACCURACY_LOW: GPS signal is too weak. Move to an open area and try again.
errors.GPS_STALE_LOCATION: Location data is outdated. Wait for a fresh GPS fix and try again.
errors.NETWORK_OFFLINE: No network connection. Some features are paused.
errors.CAMERA_PERM_DENIED: Camera permission required. Please enable in Settings.
errors.SYNC_CONFLICT: Newer cloud data detected. Choose which to keep.
errors.SENSOR_UNAVAILABLE: Your device does not support this feature.
errors.DAILY_LIMIT_REACHED: Daily check-in limit reached (10/day). Try again tomorrow.
